## Folio Independent Review — Commit dea85f9

### BUG-1 (P3) — Settings icon white-fill masking: FIXED

`src/components/Icon.tsx:32–38` — the settings icon is now:

```tsx
settings: (
  <>
    <path d="M4 7h2m6 0h8M4 17h8m6 0h2" />
    <circle cx="9" cy="7" r="3" />
    <circle cx="15" cy="17" r="3" />
  </>
)
```

The horizontal line is split into two segments that stop at each circle's edge (`M4 7h2` ends at x=6, circle center x=9 r=3 starts at x=6; `m6 0h8` starts at x=12, the far edge of the circle). No line passes under the circle, so there is nothing to mask. The circles inherit `fill="none"` from the outer SVG. The repair requires no background-matching at any viewport or active state. ✓

### `data-pending` pulse selector: FIXED

`src/main.tsx:367–372` — the fallback/error slot sets `data-pending={!error}`. When the preview fetch resolves with an error, `data-pending` becomes `"false"`.

`src/style.css:1514` — the pulse animation selector is `.preview-loading[data-pending="true"]::before`, not the bare `.preview-loading::before`. CSS attribute selectors match the string `"true"` (React serialises boolean `true` as the string `"true"` and `false` as `"false"`). The pulsing bar therefore only renders while the fetch is still in flight; on error the `::before` pseudo-element is suppressed. ✓

### Sticky-header scroll-padding-top: FIXED

`src/style.css:1543–1546`:

```css
@media (min-width: 801px) {
  html:has(.workspace-header) {
    scroll-padding-top: 112px;
  }
```

The selector uses `html:has(.workspace-header)` so the 112px offset applies only on desktop when the workspace header is present and sticky (`min-height: 88px` + 20px top/bottom padding ≈ 128px rendered, 112px gives clearance for the focus/anchor target to be visible below the header). The base rule remains `scroll-padding-top: 24px` at `html` level for the landing page, which has no sticky workspace header. ✓
